fields.description: Language used for confirmation cards, narrative fields, and chatbot replies.
fields.label: Default Output Language

fields.description: Minimum OCR confidence (0.0-1.0) before flagging for review
fields.label: Confidence Threshold

fields.description: When the conversation's OCR language is set to "auto", run a fast detector pass on each upload to pick the right Paddle model.
fields.label: Enable Language Auto-Detect

fields.description: Translate narrative fields (remarks, terms, descriptions) into the conversation's output language via the configured LLM provider.
fields.label: Enable Output Translation

fields.description: Maximum upload size in megabytes
fields.label: Max File Size (MB)

fields.description: When off, the API will never create ERPNext documents (dry-run mode).
fields.label: Enable Write Operations

fields.description: Automatically create missing Supplier/Customer/Item masters during extraction
fields.label: Auto-create Missing Masters

fields.description: Wall-clock timeout for the PaddleOCR subprocess. On expiry the request fails with OCR_TIMEOUT.
fields.label: OCR Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Stop OCR after N pages. Files exceeding this cap raise PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES.
fields.label: Max Pages per PDF

fields.description: Default rows per page on the ConfirmationCard items table. Range 5–50.
fields.label: Confirmation Card Page Size

fields.description: OCR engine preference: paddle uses PaddleOCR, ollama_vision uses the local LLaVA / minicpm-v fallback, auto tries paddle and falls back to ollama on OCRError.
fields.label: OCR Engine

fields.description: Maximum characters of OCR text inlined in tool results before truncation kicks in.
fields.label: Inline Text Budget (chars)

fields.description: Vision OCR resizes images down to this maximum dimension (px) before sending to Ollama to control token cost.
fields.label: Vision Image Max Dim (px)

fields.description: Match and apply IDP Extraction Templates during mapping
fields.label: Enable Extraction Templates

fields.description: Allow multi-file / ZIP batch processing
fields.label: Enable Batch Processing

fields.description: Record user corrections for few-shot prompting
fields.label: Enable Feedback Loop

fields.description: Auto-assign approvers and advance workflow state on create
fields.label: Enable Workflow Routing

fields.description: Expose the industry prompt library to the chatbot/LLM layer
fields.label: Enable Prompt Library

fields.description: JSON array of approver rules per DocType (see docs/TEST.md — Workflow Routing).
fields.label: Approver Rules (JSON)

fields.description: Run the LLM-backed hybrid field mapper for low-confidence extractions
fields.label: Enable Hybrid Mapper

fields.description: Active LLM provider; only one is used at a time. Custom providers can be declared in the Custom Providers (JSON) field.
fields.label: LLM Provider

fields.description: Model id, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, llama3.1:8b
fields.label: LLM Model

fields.description: Rule-mapper average confidence threshold; LLM is invoked when below this value or when required fields are missing
fields.label: Hybrid Confidence Threshold

fields.description: API key for the active provider (encrypted at rest). Ollama does not use this field.
fields.label: LLM API Key

fields.description: Base URL of the Ollama HTTP server (used when the active provider is Ollama)
fields.label: Ollama Host URL

fields.description: JSON list of additional providers, e.g. [{"name":"azure","module":"my_app.llm.azure","class":"AzureProvider"}]
fields.label: Custom Providers (JSON)

fields.description: JSON object overriding model metadata, e.g. {"gpt-4o-mini":{"input_cost_per_1k":0.0001}}
fields.label: Model Overrides (JSON)

fields.description: Per-user daily token cap; 0 = unlimited
fields.label: Daily Token Budget

fields.description: Per-user monthly token cap; 0 = unlimited
fields.label: Monthly Token Budget

fields.description: Master switch for the v2 LLM stack (provider abstraction, hybrid mapper, agent loop). When off, IDP falls back to rule-only extraction and the chatbot UI degrades to legacy mode.
fields.label: LLM Enabled

fields.description: Optional base URL override for the active provider (e.g. self-hosted proxy, Azure OpenAI endpoint). Leave blank to use the provider default.
fields.label: LLM API Base URL

fields.description: Default rule-confidence threshold below which the hybrid mapper escalates to the LLM. Per-DocType overrides live on IDP DocType Mapper Config.
fields.label: LLM Fallback Threshold (Default)

fields.description: Allow the LLM provider to receive page images when OCR text is insufficient. Vision calls are gated and capped per conversation.
fields.label: LLM Vision Enabled

fields.description: Map each model purpose (classification, extraction, vision, summarisation, confirmation) to a provider/model/tier. Cheap tier handles gating; expensive tier handles extraction.
fields.label: LLM Model Routes

fields.description: Maximum output tokens per LLM response (Anthropic/OpenAI max_tokens; Ollama num_predict). Increase when the agent's confirmation cards get truncated mid-JSON (e.g. multi-page invoices with long items/taxes tables). Typical safe range: 4096–64000 depending on model context window.
fields.label: LLM Max Output Tokens

fields.description: Hard cap on total LLM spend per day across all users. Once reached, IDP gracefully degrades to rule-only extraction.
fields.label: Daily Token Budget (USD)

fields.description: Per-user daily cap; users are warned before exceeding.
fields.label: Per-User Daily Limit (USD)

fields.description: Hard cap on tool-call iterations per conversation turn. Prevents runaway agent loops.
fields.label: Max Tool Iterations per Turn

fields.description: Email address(es) notified once the daily budget crosses 80% — comma-separated.
fields.label: Budget Alert Email

fields.description: Active conversations retained for N days, then auto-archived. Set 0 to disable auto-archive.
fields.label: Active Retention (days)

fields.description: Archived conversations retained for N days, then purged unless legal_hold is set.
fields.label: Archived Retention (days)

fields.description: Conversations in Failed status are purged after N days (legal_hold still exempts).
fields.label: Auto-Purge Failed After (days)

fields.description: Expose the conversational /idp/chat UI. When off, users are routed to the legacy SPA at /idp.
fields.label: Enable Chatbot UI

fields.description: Keep the legacy SPA available at /idp alongside the new chat UI. Turn off once users have migrated.
fields.label: Enable Legacy UI

fields.description: Stream assistant prose token-by-token over Socket.IO. Tool results and ConfirmationCards remain atomic. Disable for strict-audit environments.
fields.label: Streaming Enabled
